text:
claire: Quick sync — launch day plan draft attached here. Need confirmed owners for live monitoring, press watch, and partner onboarding window.

omar: I'll take live monitoring & dashboard alerts. Will add health checks for provisioning and billing.

hana: I'll own press watch and coordinate embargo touchpoints. Please send final snippets by EOD.

partner-kai: Kai (partner): our CSM will join +2h window and the integration engineer will be on-call for 1h post-launch.

press-bot: Embargo set 2026-07-15T17:00Z. Reminders scheduled T-24h and T-1h.

ops-bot: Ops notes: cutover uses feature flag marketplace_public, rollback window 25m. Set alerts for provisioning failure >4% in first 10m.

omar: I'll create a Slack alert channel #marketplace-live and wire alerts to SRE. Also will include a runbook quicklink.

claire: Contingency: if partner onboarding fails, show "Request access" CTA and route requests to partner CSM. Kai pls confirm email for capture.

partner-kai: Use partners@kai-inc.com for capture. We'll respond within SLA.

hana: Press owners: media@redwood.com, partners-press@kai-inc.com. I'll distribute final embargo pack at T-6h and T-30m.

claire: Owners recap: Omar=monitoring & alerts; Hana=press & embargo; Kai=partner support; Ops-bot=cutover controls. React with :white_check_mark: when green.

omar: :white_check_mark: dashboard + alerts done.

hana: :white_check_mark: embargo pack scheduled.

partner-kai: :white_check_mark: CSM and engineer confirmed.

claire: Thanks team — see you in the dry-run tomorrow 08:00 PT. If anything blocks, DM me.
